Great effort on your Warrior One pose! I see you’re really putting in the work, and I want to help you refine your practice further. Let's address a few key points to enhance your alignment and make this pose even more effective for you.

First, let's focus on your spine. It’s important to keep your spine straight throughout the pose to maintain proper alignment and stability. Take a moment to draw your shoulder blades down your back as you lift your chest. Engaging your core will also help you keep that nice, elongated spine. Imagine a string gently pulling the crown of your head upward.

Next, regarding your arms, I noticed that they’re not as straight up as they could be. Try to reach your arms overhead with intention, spreading your fingers wide and creating space between them. This will not only help you find more length in your torso, but it also encourages an open heart, which is essential in Warrior One. 

Lastly, let’s talk about your knees. It’s crucial for your knee to be directly over your ankle to maintain balance and to protect your joints. Take a moment to check your knee alignment; it should track in the same direction as your toes. If you find it straying out to the side or collapsing in, make subtle adjustments by grounding through your back heel and engaging your legs to support a stable stance.

Remember, yoga is a journey, and I’m here to support you every step of the way. Let’s take it one breath at a time, making these adjustments and really feeling into the pose. You’re doing wonderfully, and I’m excited to see how these corrections help you grow in this practice!
